referenceConfidence: High weapon/mechanism identification; approximate authored transforms and phase timing.

mechanism.layout: Bullpup rear box magazine behind the walnut pistol grip
mechanism.action: Muzzle-up roll, old magazine leaves rear socket, fresh box comes from below, seats, then weapon rolls back to hip

observations.fact: Inventory view and matching hip silhouette identify the Bygones walnut/green receiver, rear magazine, and compact tube optic.
From hip, the gun pitches muzzle-up and presents its side, keeping the right hand on the pistol grip.
Left hand works the rear magazine behind the grip; the box clears the rear stock opening and leaves the visible socket area.
A separate fresh rectangular magazine enters from below-left and rises into the rear opening; the left hand presses its base.
The inserted magazine remains seated while the left hand releases and the gun returns to hip.
Slow-motion repeat corroborates the muzzle-up rear-magazine exchange and separate insertion/press/recovery phases.

extraction.method: yt-dlp download, ffmpeg -ss timestamp -frames:v 1 -vf scale=640:360; inspected extracted contact sheets

rejectedCandidates.reason: Private video; no frame evidence used
Viewed genuine Bygones but combat/sprint obscured candidate reload; not used to author the curve

limitations: Numeric rotations, local displacements and normalized phase boundaries are manually authored, not measured bone transforms or an animation extraction.
One magazine model is a visual proxy for departing and incoming magazines; no two-magazine handoff, dropping physics, fingers, hands or IK.
A rigid box follows its source 11-degree insertion axis; no independent magazine spin, charging latch or bolt action is claimed.
640x360 compressed footage and hand occlusion limit exact travel/contact inference. Reference paint matches current cleaned W134 geometry stored in W123; original PBR is not reproduced.
Offline renders and parser/codec acceptance do not prove native framing, input, hand contact or 10-20 weapon performance. Master native QA remains pending.
